elements.name: Shipment Planning
elements.documentation: Ability to book carriers and schedule shipments reliably at current volumes.

elements.name: Carrier Management
elements.documentation: Ability to vet, contract, and monitor carriers on current performance data.

elements.name: Customer Inquiry Handling
elements.documentation: Ability to receive, triage, and answer customer inquiries consistently across branches.

elements.name: Order Management
elements.documentation: Ability to manage the shipment order lifecycle from quote to delivery confirmation.

elements.name: Performance Analytics
elements.documentation: Ability to measure carrier and shipment performance on current, governed data.

elements.name: Carrier Network
elements.documentation: The contracted carrier base Meridian can plan and book against.

elements.name: Customer Service Team
elements.documentation: Trained service staff across branches who run inquiry and order handling.

elements.name: Integration Platform
elements.documentation: The integration capability estate (hub, broker, APIs) available to connect systems.

elements.name: Customer Service Representative
elements.documentation: Front-line employee who takes inquiries, quotes shipments, and updates customers.

elements.name: Operations Planner
elements.documentation: Back-office planner who books carriers, schedules shipments, and onboards carriers.

elements.name: Handle Customer Inquiry
elements.documentation: Intake and triage of customer questions; decides whether pricing or tracking is needed.

elements.name: Quote Shipment
elements.documentation: Produces a priced quote for a shipment request and records the resulting order.

elements.name: Plan Shipment
elements.documentation: Selects a carrier, books capacity, and schedules the shipment.

elements.name: Track Shipment
elements.documentation: Monitors in-transit shipments and keeps the customer's status record current.

elements.name: Onboard Carrier
elements.documentation: Vets a new carrier, contracts it, and creates its governed carrier profile.

elements.name: Quoting Service
elements.documentation: The customer-facing service of pricing a shipment request.

elements.name: Tracking Service
elements.documentation: The customer-facing service of reporting shipment status.

elements.name: Carrier Onboarding Service
elements.documentation: The carrier-facing service of contracting and registering new carriers.

elements.name: Shipment Order
elements.documentation: The business record of one booked shipment: parties, terms, and status.

elements.name: Carrier Profile
elements.documentation: The governed business record describing a carrier: contracts, lanes, performance.

elements.name: CarrierDesk TMS
elements.documentation: Legacy transport management system holding quoting and shipment planning logic.

elements.name: SalesCloud CRM
elements.documentation: CRM holding customer records and inquiry history for the service desk.

elements.name: TrackIt Customer Portal
elements.documentation: Pilot self-service portal where customers track their shipments.

elements.name: FreightHub Integration Hub
elements.documentation: New integration layer that connects TMS, CRM, portal, and external carrier feeds.

elements.name: Quote Management Service
elements.documentation: Automated service that prices a shipment request using rates and customer data.

elements.name: Shipment Tracking Service
elements.documentation: Service that aggregates carrier status events into one shipment tracking view.

elements.name: Carrier Data Management Service
elements.documentation: Service that maintains the single governed carrier dataset behind carrier processes.

elements.name: Rate Calculation
elements.documentation: Function computing shipment prices from tariffs, lanes, and customer agreements.

elements.name: Status Aggregation
elements.documentation: Function collecting carrier status feeds and deriving one shipment status.

elements.name: Shipment Record
elements.documentation: Application-level data instance of a shipment order used by rating and tracking.

elements.name: Carrier Scorecard
elements.documentation: Application-level dataset of carrier performance indicators fed by status aggregation.

elements.name: Customer Record
elements.documentation: Application-level customer master data used for pricing tiers and service history.

elements.name: Brokerage Application Server
elements.documentation: Server estate hosting the TMS and the customer portal applications.

elements.name: Integration Gateway
elements.documentation: Server running the integration hub with message broker and API management.

elements.name: Message Broker
elements.documentation: Middleware queuing carrier feed messages for the integration hub.

elements.name: API Management Platform
elements.documentation: Gateway managing and securing the APIs exposed to carriers and applications.

elements.name: carrierdesk-tms.ear
elements.documentation: Deployable enterprise archive of the CarrierDesk TMS application.

elements.name: trackit-portal.war
elements.documentation: Deployable web archive of the TrackIt customer portal.

elements.name: freighthub-integration.jar
elements.documentation: Deployable module implementing the FreightHub integration flows.

elements.name: Secure Message Transport
elements.documentation: Encrypted transport service used for carrier data feeds into the platform.

elements.name: Chief Operating Officer
elements.documentation: Owns brokerage operations; sponsors the uplift to protect margin and service levels.

elements.name: Head of Customer Service
elements.documentation: Accountable for inquiry handling quality; worried about slow quotes and manual re-keying.

elements.name: Chief Financial Officer
elements.documentation: Guards profitability; needs cost per shipment to fall measurably.

elements.name: IT Manager
elements.documentation: Owns the application estate; concerned about integration debt and growing data volumes.

elements.name: Customer
elements.documentation: Shippers contracting Meridian; expect transparent, self-service shipment status.

elements.name: Rising Customer Expectations for Shipment Visibility
elements.documentation: External pressure: shippers compare Meridian's transparency with larger brokers' portals.

elements.name: Margin Pressure on Brokerage Operations
elements.documentation: Competitive freight market squeezes brokerage margins on every booking.

elements.name: Growing Volume of Carrier and Shipment Data
elements.documentation: More carriers and shipments produce data that spreadsheets can no longer absorb.

elements.name: Carrier Performance Tracked in Offline Spreadsheets
elements.documentation: Weekly manual scorecard updates lag reality, so carrier selection rests on stale figures.

elements.name: Customer Service Staff Re-key Order Data Between Systems
elements.documentation: Double entry between CRM and TMS wastes time and introduces quoting errors.

elements.name: Reduce Quote Turnaround From 4 Hours to 30 Minutes
elements.documentation: Cut the time from inquiry to priced quote so Meridian stops losing rate-shopped loads.

elements.name: Increase On-time Delivery Rate to 95 Percent
elements.documentation: Lift delivery reliability to retain shippers who measure carrier performance.

elements.name: Provide Single Source of Truth for Carrier Data
elements.documentation: One governed carrier record set feeding every process, ending spreadsheet divergence.

elements.name: Reduce Cost Per Shipment by 12 Percent
elements.documentation: Lower operating cost per booking through less manual work and better carrier choices.

elements.name: Faster, More Consistent Customer Answers
elements.documentation: Customers receive accurate status and quotes in minutes regardless of branch or agent.

elements.name: Reduced Operating Cost Per Shipment
elements.documentation: The measurable end result of the cost goal on Meridian's P&L.

elements.name: Provide Self-service Shipment Tracking for Customers
elements.documentation: Customers must see shipment status in a portal without calling the service desk.

elements.name: Integrate Carrier Data Feeds Into One Platform
elements.documentation: Carrier feeds must land in one integration platform instead of per-team spreadsheets.

elements.name: Standardize Customer Service Process Across Branches
elements.documentation: All branches follow one inquiry-handling process so service quality stops depending on location.
